steps.name: musiqa
steps.prompt: Dark investigative documentary underscore for a mystery explainer. Slow tense pulse at 80 BPM, low cello and contrabass drones, sparse felt piano notes, soft ticking clock texture, distant timpani swells, building suspense, a hushed reveal moment around 45 seconds, then calm unresolved ending. No vocals, no heavy drums, cinematic, true crime style.
